obligation.what_is_open: Within \(A_{n,m,\tau}<L_m^{1-\varkappa}\), match the proved lower expression with one computable learner over the full heterogeneous Hall class, or exhibit a harder same-class configuration; thereby decide the exact vanishing criterion and the maximal strict-improvement regimes relative to \(\mathcal B_{\mathrm{CK}}\).
obligation.obstruction: Simultaneous coordinatewise control attains only \(\min\{\ell,A_{n,m,\tau}L_m^{\varkappa}\}\). The missing oracle inequality must instead control the random mixture mass of severely underestimated arms selected under capacity, uniformly over heterogeneous indices and local ties; the frozen primitives provide no such localized selected-mixture concentration result.
obligation.attempted: The paired product-prior converse, fixed-sample posterior factorization, capacity exchange, binomial missed-cell lower bound, and amplitude optimization already close the lower side. A natural-threshold empirical minimizer and an average multiplicative core comparison were also tried, but rare severe underestimation can be selected adaptively; restoring simultaneous control reproduces the coordinatewise logarithmic factor.
obligation.partial_result:
Put \(A_{n,m,\tau}:=\ell\min\{1,N^{-\varkappa}\}\) and \(L_m:=\log(2m)\). The familywise phase is now closed:
\[
A_{n,m,\tau}\geq L_m^{1-\varkappa}
\quad\Longrightarrow\quad
\mathcal R(n,m,\tau)\asymp_{\beta,D}
\mathcal B_{\mathrm{CK}}(n,m,\tau)
=\min\{\ell,A_{n,m,\tau}L_m^{\varkappa}\}.
\]
This comparison includes saturation, and the risk is bounded away from zero throughout that phase. In the complementary phase the proved bracket is
\[
c_{\beta,D}\min\!\left\{\ell,
A_{n,m,\tau}\left[1+A_{n,m,\tau}^{\varkappa/(1-\varkappa)}\right]\right\}
\leq\mathcal R(n,m,\tau)
\leq C_{\beta,D}\min\{\ell,A_{n,m,\tau}L_m^{\varkappa}\}.
\]
Hence \(A_{n,m,\tau}\to0\) is necessary for vanishing regret, while \(A_{n,m,\tau}L_m^{\varkappa}\to0\) is sufficient. Every vanishing-regret sequence satisfies \(\mathcal R(n,m,\tau)/\mathcal B_{\mathrm{AW}}(n,m)\to\infty\). The remaining issue is only the sub-familywise selected-mixture upper bound, or a harder same-class lower configuration.

body.justification: The familywise phase and the all-vanishing-regime regular-policy comparison are now settled; the remaining headline contribution is exactly the localized selected-mixture frontier below the elbow.
body.gap: CarpentierKim2015 supplies translated one-tail familywise machinery but no randomized capacity-selected mixture oracle inequality below the elbow, and AtheyWager2021 supplies no moving extreme-mixture rate.
body.consumer: Resolving the sub-familywise gap would tell users of the non-nested upper-cost-quantile objective in OsamaZachariahStoica2020 exactly when capacity averaging permits reliable Hall extrapolation beyond the now-certified familywise obstruction.
